# Tayyab — Full Stack Developer Portfolio

> https://thisistayyab.dev

Tayyab is a full stack web developer with 3+ years of production experience. He specializes in React, Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Node.js, Express, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Supabase, WebSockets, WebRTC, SaaS platforms, and AI automation. He has solved over 1,150+ problems on LeetCode using C++. Tayyab is available for freelance, contract, and full-time remote work building SaaS products, REST APIs, retail POS and CRM systems, and real-time web applications.

## Featured Products & Case Studies

### 1. Tillqorin POS — Commerce OS for Retail
Web-based retail POS, invoicing, and inventory management system built by Tayyab. Includes barcode scanning, 80mm/58mm thermal receipt printing, transactional stock locking, sales analytics, and multi-register support. Backed by React, Vite, Express.js, and Supabase (PostgreSQL).
- Portfolio Case Study: https://thisistayyab.dev/projects/tillqorin
- Live POS App: https://pos.taylancetech.com/

### 2. AuditBloc — Web Accessibility & Compliance Scanner
Automated website accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA), GDPR cookie banner, and AI content disclosure scanner. Built with Next.js 16, FastAPI, Playwright for headless browser testing, axe-core for WCAG accessibility rule validation, and Supabase.
- Portfolio Case Study: https://thisistayyab.dev/projects/auditbloc
- Live Scanner: https://auditbloc.taylancetech.com/

### 3. Relay — Real-Time Text & P2P File Transfer
Privacy-first real-time collaboration web application featuring instant shared notepad sync and direct peer-to-peer file transfer via DTLS-encrypted WebRTC data channels. Built with React, Node.js, Express, and Socket.IO. Requires zero user accounts and stores zero files on servers.
- Portfolio Case Study: https://thisistayyab.dev/projects/relay
- Live App: https://relay.thisistayyab.dev/

### 4. Taylance CRM — Clients, Leads & Projects Dashboard
Full-featured B2B CRM web application architected and built by Tayyab to manage clients, sales pipelines, leads, and projects from one unified dashboard. Built with React, Node.js, Express.js, and Material UI with role-based access control and pipeline analytics.
- Portfolio Case Study: https://thisistayyab.dev/projects/taylance-crm
- Live App: https://crm.taylancetech.com/

### 5. YouTube Video Downloader — Private Archival Tool
Fast, high-fidelity YouTube video and audio extraction web application built with Next.js, yt-dlp, and FFmpeg. Private password-locked tool for personal backups with live download progress.
- Portfolio Case Study: https://thisistayyab.dev/projects/youtube-downloader
- Live App: https://downloader.thisistayyab.dev/ (Private)

## Core Skills & Stack

- **Frontend**: React 19, Next.js 16 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS3, Core Web Vitals optimization
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Express.js, FastAPI, REST APIs, WebSockets (Socket.IO), WebRTC, Supabase, authentication & webhooks
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Supabase Database, transactional RPCs, schema design & query tuning
- **Problem Solving & Algorithms**: 1,150+ LeetCode problems solved with C++ (Data Structures, Graph Algorithms, Dynamic Programming)
- **SEO & Accessibility**: Technical SEO, Schema.org JSON-LD structured data, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, Playwright + axe-core automation, AVIF/WebP optimization
- **Tooling & Cloud**: Docker, Playwright, Git, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Render, Linux
